title: Composition of the two supplied scalar delta squares
statement: For UniformizerSquareData q, the successive derived scalar functor applied to the initial arrow and followed by ScalarCompatibility.compositeTarget equals ScalarCompatibility.compositeSource.hom followed by the final arrow. This uses exactly the first and second ScalarCompatibility.delta equations and no ordinary finite realization.

source.place: paragraph (1), finite cyclic reduction followed by finite coefficient extension

proof.text: Map the first scalar delta equation through the quotient derived scalar functor. Apply the second scalar delta equation, compose the supported-source isomorphisms and shifted target arrows, and reassociate.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1), finite cyclic reduction followed by finite coefficient extension
proof_origin.note: Separate the supported-constant and positive-root endpoint calculations from naturality of an arbitrary diagonal arrow.

def UniformizerSquareData.successive_square
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l) (π : PadicAlgCl.integers l E) (n : ℕ)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (hA : ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : A) = 0)
    (q : UniformizerSquareData l Y E π n A hA)
